name: dsh-minato-bridge
description: Optional read-only bridge: writes a small JSON snapshot of dsh session/token state for DeepSeek Harness Toolkit (the standalone Windows toolkit). No model calls, no writes to dsh state. 0.2.0 adds per-session live activity (seq-delta -> active/lastActiveAt), so the panel can tell 'running' from 'parked in dsh'.
